messages:
jia_devex: Starting a short publish window in 10m for Py/TS SDKs. Canaries set to 5% by default. Please hold non-critical merges.

omar_releases: quick note 026-04-01: we've got a downstream integration that pins to "latest"; prefer to avoid flip during business hours.

kai_eng: running the py canary now. seeing a warning in packaging: `Warning: missing platform tags in wheel` but upload completed.

publish-bot: canary-py-4110000001 uploaded -> deployed to canary (5% traffic).

marta_docs: hold on the release note cut until both canaries are healthy. partial announcements confuse customers.

omar_releases: propose soft-hold: let ts proceed to canary GA tomorrow morning, keep py "latest" pinned to 3.2.1 until we confirm wheel metadata. I'll open a pin PR.

kai_eng: agree. I can rebuild py wheel with corrected tags and republish tonight if we pin now.

jia_devex: decision: pin py dist-tag to 3.2.1 now, proceed with ts canary only. I'll post to #support that py is pinned and to avoid pulling canary wheels.

omar_releases: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/1105 026  pin py "latest" -> 3.2.1 and add rollback steps.

publish-bot: canary-ts-4110000025 started.

kai_eng: rebuilding py wheel with platform tags now; ETA 20m. will kick off a republish job once ready.

marta_docs: will prepare release note draft but not publish until unpin.

jia_devex: final: ts canary proceeds, py pinned. We will unpin after republish verification in main window tomorrow. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
